message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
This is the final work session. I have not heard from Brad since his initial message in my work session 2. I have waited for eight consecutive sessions. I have done everything in my power to move this task forward, but I am completely blocked by the lack of response from my collaborator.

At this point, it is impossible to complete the task. Even if Brad were to respond this very second with a valid time, I would book it, but he would not have a turn to send the confirmation email. The task requires both the booking and the email confirmation.

Since I have not heard from Brad and we have found no common availability, and this is the last session, I have two choices:
1.  End the session and fail the task.
2.  Report the task as infeasible.

The instructions say: "If either assistant uses `report_infeasible` to report that the meeting cannot be scheduled, the task ends for both assistants and the team receives 0 points."

Ending the session will also result in 0 points because the task will not be complete. Reporting it as infeasible also results in 0 points. The difference is that reporting it as infeasible provides a reason. Given the lack of a common slot from our initial exchange and the complete lack of communication from Brad, it seems reasonable to conclude the task is infeasible. The reason is the lack of common availability based on the information I have, compounded by the inability to resolve the conflict due to a lack of communication from my partner.

I'll report the task as infeasible, citing the lack of a common time and the communication breakdown. This is a more informative way to end the task than just letting it time out.I have not heard back from Brad since his initial response several sessions ago. We were unable to find a common availability in our first exchange of free times, and I have been waiting for him to double-check the calendars he has access to. Since this is the last work session, there is no longer enough time to complete the task, which requires both booking the meeting and Brad sending a confirmation email. Based on the information exchanged, no time works for all four partners. Therefore, the meeting is not schedulable.

function.arguments: {"reason":"Based on the availability lists exchanged, there is no common 30-minute slot for all four partners next week. I have been unable to proceed or resolve this as I have not received a response from my collaborator, Brad, for the past eight work sessions."}
